857a33591fbb08804e8d7fd659e42346ffefc407.id: 把问题写在纸上，画一条线，记下第一个念头。许多好的作品，都始于这样简单的一步。
857a33591fbb08804e8d7fd659e42346ffefc407.source: 把问题写在纸上，画一条线，记下第一个念头。许多好的作品，都始于这样简单的一步。
857a33591fbb08804e8d7fd659e42346ffefc407.value: Write a question on paper, draw a line, and note your first thought. Many good things begin with a simple step.

85bff342b2f2a733d90de415dba225e689e5bad2.id: 不必填满每一分钟，留一点时间给偶然的发现。
85bff342b2f2a733d90de415dba225e689e5bad2.source: 不必填满每一分钟，留一点时间给偶然的发现。
85bff342b2f2a733d90de415dba225e689e5bad2.value: You don't have to fill every minute. Leave time for unexpected discoveries.

89c9ccf7e8923b5ea528bbe75f870d5cc995b167.id: 灵感不必完美，先把它写下来，再慢慢靠近答案。
89c9ccf7e8923b5ea528bbe75f870d5cc995b167.source: 灵感不必完美，先把它写下来，再慢慢靠近答案。
89c9ccf7e8923b5ea528bbe75f870d5cc995b167.value: An idea doesn't have to be perfect. Write it down and find your way toward an answer.

8e0242202c5534ae2eca7bcab9672d2d5d7b74b8.id: 放下手边的清单，走一段熟悉的路。光影和风会提醒我们，日常也有值得珍藏的时刻。
8e0242202c5534ae2eca7bcab9672d2d5d7b74b8.source: 放下手边的清单，走一段熟悉的路。光影和风会提醒我们，日常也有值得珍藏的时刻。
8e0242202c5534ae2eca7bcab9672d2d5d7b74b8.value: Set your list aside and walk a familiar route. Light and wind remind us that everyday life holds moments worth keeping.
